relationships.subject: MFSD2A
relationships.evidence_quote: major facilitator superfamily domain containing 2A (MFSD2A), a lipid/sodium transmembrane symporter, plays a key role in the regulating BBB transport by inhibiting transcytosis

key_findings: BBB and peripheral nerve barriers (perineurium, BNB) share tight junctions and transporters, so CNS drug delivery strategies may be adapted to peripheral nerves.
